title: verify-invariants reports what is new, and user tooling can share the cross-worktree lock
desiredOutcome: verify-invariants can show only breaches that are new against a committed baseline, a baseline entry that no longer matches is reported, and user tooling can take the plugin's cross-worktree lock under a namespaced name

tasks.title: verify-invariants reports only what is new against a committed baseline, and user tooling can take a namespaced cross-worktree lock
tasks.description: A long history reported 8040 frozen breaches and the operator grepped for today's SHAs. Add a committed baseline of breach fingerprints (check id + subject + SHA - frozen history is SHA-stable): write it with an explicit flag, and when it exists print new breaches plus the baseline count; a baseline entry that no longer matches is reported, never dropped. The plugin's cross-worktree lock under git-common-dir/audit-locks refuses every name but index/usage/phase-<id>, so user tooling (an e2e guard driving one backend from several worktrees) cannot share it: admit a namespaced user-<name> through _locks.valid_name and document audit-lock.py acquire user-<name> --wait N in worktree.md.
